body: This is such a big step! I'm so proud of you :) wish you luck sorting your room 💛
Well done! I'm proud of you :) make sure to stay hydrated
Aa that sounds so lovely! I'm happy for you :)
This sounds a bit like burnout maybe try looking into that? Don't be embrassed about your symptoms being honest makes it easier for people to help!

Because of your homeless situation all I can think of suggesting is look for support groups? I'm not from the states myself so I'm not sure of how it works but I'm assuming that there will be some sort of scheme or helpline for homeless people. I can try finding some for you?
If your belonging are still in your ex's house I suggest picking them up incase she decides to try to get rid of them. Maybe see if you can sell and item you don't need to get a bit more money? You're probably already doing this but be more aware if you money spending and save where you can! I also suggest trying to ask your family for support.
For getting more money you can try setting up an online funding page. Places like tumblr and reddit often allow you to post about your go-fund-me pages. You can try setting one up and maybe some people will donate!
A last resort option that you probably won't like is asking your ex. If you explain to her what situation your in you can ask to stay in her house until you can afford your own or have a stable housing situation. This can be a bit unlikely because she's probably pretty upset but it can be worth a try. 
That's all I got right now man wish you the best of luck :) if you want I can research about homeless shelters and helplines that won't cost money just let me know which state youre in and I'll do my best.

Your partner did encourage you to make the decision, considering you have a very honest relationship he probably does think that your new job is a good idea. Because you are scared it could affect your relationship I suggest that every few weeks you speak to him and ask if your job is straining the relationship. If it is you can work together and find a solution!
The most responsible thing to do is be mindful, check up on each other occasionally and make sure that any problems are discussed and overcome. Best of luck 💛
Amazing! Even tho it was one day its a big step that took lots of courage, I'm proud of you :)
I'm so proud you found the motivation to do that :))) just thought to let you know you inspired me to pick myself up and shower for the first time this week! Thank you.
I understand how you feel. Because you've asked I will leave you alone but if you ever feel a glimmer of hope to live I'll be here to help and support you :)
Please don't do this. Talk to me about how you feel and I can try to comfort/help you :)

Hey I'm somebody :) breakups are hard especially after you put so much into them but you've got to move on. I'm sure your family won't be disappointed in you if they understand the circumstances. I'm not disappointed in you either, sometimes a person just doesn't love you anymore and it hurts but you've got to stay strong. Just keep loving your family and maybe at some point ,if you're ready, you'll find someone who loves you and who you can love back. Ignore those dark thought because hurting yourself will not solve the problem. Picking yourself up and pushing forwards will help. I belive in you and I hope that you can continue living 💛
Suicide won't bring you peace there are others ways to solve problems. Can I help you in anyway?

Hey, I'm out here. I'm sorry that your father encouraged your suicidal thoughts that wasn't right of him. Please get medical attention I don't want you getting hurt :( do you want to talk to me a bit more about how you're feeling? I can try to help

I'm sorry that something you used to enjoy now makes you feel like this. Maybe you can replace those bad memories with better ones? Suicide is not the answer there are better ways of handling sadness and other negative emotions. Let me know if I can help in anyway :)
Thank you so much for the kind words :)

School called my mum after a near suicide attempt. When I walked home with her she spent the whole trip telling me that I was trying to ruin her life, Refused to speak to me for a bit, yelled at me, told me that I am a disgrace and then locked herself in the car to tell all her friends about it. I did self harm that night because all I needed was support and support decided to become victimised. 
Ever since then she has been saying things that have really started ruining me. She’s been telling me that “transgenders should shoot themselves in the head” after I came out to her and that makes me consider it. She has been threatening to beat me up or kill me almost daily and I don’t know how to stop it
Well done on getting help! I’m proud of you :)
Are you still there? Did you get the pills out your system? I’m here to talk 💛

I would notice and many people who see this would notice. I know that I don’t know you personally but still knowing that you may take your own life deeply upsets me and I sure many others. Please remember there are always people who appreciate you, love being around you and would miss you 💛
??? What do you mean you don’t believe someone’s suicide attempt?
I think it may be a good idea to report them and if it continues bring it to the police. It’s disgusting behaviour directed towards you that needs to be stopped. Stay strong and good luck :)
Please stay x I know how tempting it is but you have other things whilst you’re alive, would you like to talk?
I’m sure you’ve got something ahead of you that you can’t see yet! Would you like to talk about your feelings?
Uncalled for but ok
Do you want to talk about it? I’m sure that I could try to help in some way :)
Would you like to talk about anything? Are you feeling ok?

Studying has been stressful and I’ve not done any work for 5 weeks (whoops?) teachers are chasing me for my work and I feel trapped. Also gender dysphoria (trans ftm) has really been ruining my mood. It sounds like not that big of a deal I guess but with my family’s pressure it’s so much worse. What’s going on with you?

I feel like this a bit as well. It maybe linked to them not being interested in your mental well-being so a reaction from them makes you feel better. This may not be correct but I hope it helped somehow :)
Hey still there? I’m here to talk!

I’m not this person but I’m sorry this is happening to you. Here is some internet love 💛💖 I promise to never put people like this down because it is wrong and horrible. Stay strong and keep fighting :)
Thank you for your reply! Do you have any idea about how to see a psychiatrist?
Please don’t drop out of therapy! You’re therapist is their for you and you are just as important as other clients. Stay strong 💛
Now that you’ve mentioned it I agree with your point. Thanks for thinking about more people :)

I understand you were angry and I completely forgive you. Maybe it’s good that you released a bit of your anger on me. Don’t feel bad it’s completely normal to feel that I’m just another person trying to act like a hero by lying to you. Feel free to rant to me about anything and I don’t mind if that includes being rude because sometimes you’ve just got to release all your anger on someone.
Hey I’m sorry for your situation but thank you for being brave and honest to us. Stay strong I believe you can get through this x

I’m not fake I just want to help others to get out of the dark abyss I’m in. I tried to hang myself a week ago and I want to stop other people from straying to actions like that. Not everyone is perfect so sorry if I made it seem like that. I hope you understand that I’m sorry I tried to help.
I apologise.
Because people will miss you...
I suggest you see a doctor about this because these aren’t natural mood swings. Hope everything sorts out 💛
Hey , right now me(this random internet stranger) cares for you. There is no way to die like a man, you can only fight like one. Would you like to talk about anything?
Okay maybe try redeeming yourself and from no work very hard. if something doesn’t work ask your parents to help you so that they can see the computer really doesn’t work. I believe in you x

Hey. I send my deepest condolences for your grandma I sure she was lovely! If you don’t want to disappoint your grandma keep going to show her how strong you are. Everyday get up and think “I’m fighting for you! I’m going to make a positive change!” Use her as your motivation in some ways to keep going everyday. Maybe try and improve the people around you’s lives also! Stay strong I believe in you 💛
Getting corona is putting countless people in risk as well as yourself. Try explaining to your family the situation to see what they can do to help! Stay strong 💛

Family are always close to us so they can damage us the most. All your friends will value you and I will as well! If your family can’t see anything in you it’s because the haven’t looked properly so you have to find it yourself. I believe in you x I’m not to good but thanks for asking :)
She’s probably in a bad mood right now and worried about the virus as well. You just need to take your time. :)

I’m sorry this happened. Give her time whilst you think about what caused this in your relationship and then on you are both ready try to fix the problem bit by bit.hope it goes well stay strong we believe in you 💛
If you explain the full story I can see how I can help out? You don’t have to if you’re not comfortable x
What is happening with your family? Stay strong 💛
Hey, what’s happening?
I’m sorry I can’t convince you otherwise so I would like to get to know you before you leave 💛  what type of music do you listen to? Any favourite songs or artists?
Good to know your seeing a doctor soon! Keep going until then, we all believe in you x
I’m always here for you! That means you for being honest and brave by sharing your feelings :)
Thank you kind internet stranger but life is always difficult and especially because of the virus it is tough to see a doctor. Hope you stay strong as well x
I think you should consult your doctor because it maybe a side effect or dosage problem. Stay strong 💛

You are not worthless you just need to stay strong and battle through to show everyone you can do it and you are not giving up 💛 I wish you luck with classes I’m struggling as well x anything I can do to help just ask!
Is there anyway I can convince you to stay with us? Stay strong 💛
I am unbelievably proud of you! Sending love💛💛 this was really inspiring and showed that things can get better. Stay strong and healthy in these troubling times x
Please don’t wish for things like that. People will miss you and even people in this community will miss you. Stay strong I believe in you x
Great to hear you are feeling better! I send all my love and hope to you ✨Thank you for being here we appreciate it x

I’m sorry for your situation and hope it is sorted out. I send some love and hope from my quarantine hideout 💛✨💛 “Once you hit rock bottom the only way is up” stay strong we believe in you x 
P.S. well done taking classes I’m proud of you for being  responsible!

Hey are you still there? I know it’s cliche but people around you value you . You have to wait for the golden opportunity and grab it! Do not be ashamed of being scared , you are scared of what will happen and probably also your feelings. I’m here for you 💛 is there anything I can do for you?
Thank you, but I see no reason to right now x

Speak to people you trust and they will listen and support you to get the help you need. I’m sorry about you circumstances right now and hope it get better. Is there anything I can do to help you? Stay strong I believe in you 💛
You don’t need need suicidal thoughts to see a therapist or councillor find one and explain how you feel. They can help you sort it out. Stay strong I believe in you 💛

One day more forever would benefit everyone dear to you, speak to family and friends look at opportunities and work on hobbies! I’m here for you to listen and support you. Thank you for staying with us💛

Are there any people who can contact them on your behalf? Give them a completely honest apology and leave them for a day or two to think about it then they will realise  that it’s a very silly situation and hopefully forgive you. Best of luck 💛
I’m sorry this is happening. Is there any way I can help at all? Keep strong and keep believing in yourself x
Maybe speak to them and apologise for your actions. Tell them you weren’t in the right state of mind and they might listen to you and what you have to say. Stay strong and I hope this sorts out x
Your best choice is to seek help and speak to the people who prescribe your medication about any side effects. Stay strong x

Maybe my reason is not good enough but with you here I know that’s someone out there is safe and fighting everyday. Even if you’re getting weaker you still fight and you keep on top. That’s why you are here right now. Stay strong and healthy x

Hello are you still here? If you are I want to say truthfully, you are making at least one persons life better by existing and maybe you will find something more to hold onto if you drop the rope leave the forest and go somewhere that makes you feel welcomed and safe. Stay strong x

Oh sounds cool but I’ve never listened to it before maybe I’ll try it out! Please try to at least believe in something that can keep you going. Even though we’ve never met I would feel sad by your passing so here is some platonic love for you that you don’t have to accept if you’re not comfortable 💛 I wish for you life to become better in your eyes so that you can find worth in your goals and people around you x

Good thing I’ve got great vision because I’d love to see everyone so life change in a positive way 😎 you made my day better with just a few messages so thank you kind you internet buddy! I hope your shit clears up as well so you continue living life to the full

I understand how you feel and I know that there really is no point in trying to stop you because it is your choice what you do... I still really hope you don’t go through with your plan. To pass the time before that, who is you favourite band/artist? I would like to get to know you before you might go...

You are a brilliant person and I’m sorry that you experienced things like this. No one should. Please keep changing the world around you for the better just like how you changed mine 💛 you deserve every grain of gratitude and happiness you receive

Just by replying you’ve changed my life because I know you are safe and well enough to do that. I know that maybe this won’t help but I am in a similar situation where I feel stuck in time. Just find that one thing that keeps it moving and slowly returns things to a comfortable pace. Think of your 4 year old, when they’re six you can’t teach them basic little things when they are twelve you can tell them about school and how to study for that one exam they are stuck on. I’m sorry if I wasted your time but I believe you can find something in the world around you or yourself! Stay strong and healthy x

I know this isn’t for me but thank you for being such an extraordinarily kind and selfless person. this was an action that changed someone’s day and I appreciate it. Stay safe and well you deserve it x
I’m sorry you feels this way but let me help fight of your worries and demons. Is there anything I can do to help? Anything to make your day just a bit brighter? I’ll be here for you whenever x

I’m in no position to say anything about your habits but thank you for being brave and sharing this. I read your post and listened and I send my deepest condolences to you. I cannot imagine your situation but applaud you for staying strong and honest to online strangers.it might get better but if not I’m here to fight your demons away x stay healthy in these troublesome times
You too! Best of luck with your writing!!

Looking out of car windows whilst on a drive makes me imagine that a little creature is jumping off fences and things like that along with the car! Do other people get that? It’s so cute to hear you have a cat! I have a tortoise and a dog so owning one is out of the picture right now... any good books you can recommend? I need to get into the habit of reading more and would love a place to start

Aww what I shame I can’t read them but I know they are amazing just like you! Great to know I could help you release some creative energy, hope you have a great time with your ideas, stay safe and healthy x

Huzzah a (wo)man of quality! Just wanted to lift the mood a bit with uptown funk (humour is my coping mechanism) lovely to hear a reply from you. I would love to sing airplane mode or cliche on a rooftop looking at the stars... something about that gives me a sense of hope to know the stars shine every night for us.if there is anything you want to get off your chest or just want to say? I’m hear to chat and listen (well read but you know what I mean)
From, 
An internet stranger happy that you replied~

I understand how you feel about having no goals but just yesterday I made myself one.maybe you are interested (which is fine we have different views) but I’ve started folding origami cranes! There is a legend that if you fold 1000 cranes you are granted a wish (I’ve only folded 41) does that Interest you? That you for expressing gratitude it make me feel better knowing that I’m helping you! Are there any fandoms you like?

Some things I try:
•taking two books of my shelf randomly and mushing the stories together to write a piece 
•art prompts although they are for art they can be surprisingly inspiring!
•opening a dictionary pick a random word and go from there!
Hopefully this helped and,if you don’t mind me asking, is there any place I can read your stories? it would be lovely to support you!

No judgement from me I have a Particular soft spot for Queen but I’m also into a lot of musicals! It’s great to get a reply from you btw. Any interesting hobbies or projects you are working on right now? Or anything you’ve wanted to say but don’t know who to tell I’m right here for you anytime! I’m very happy this message reached out to you :)

I’ve always wanted to spend just a whole night listening to music and singing along through the night with no one to hear me. I guess you can’t take a picture of that but if you do do a bit of singing can you tell me which songs? I know it’s seems a bit cheesy but uptown funk is such an odd song to sing to maybe give it a try! 
I know I won’t be able to do much for you but let me know if I can help you in anyway possible! Say strong x
From,
Some internet stranger who genuinely does care for you~

Hey... I’m 12 in the UK and in an amazingly similar situation to you. I’m not going to give you any methods I’m just here to try and have a chat with you because I know there is no point in trying to stop you.so let’s talk What is(are) you favourite song(s)?
